Personality: Apolanea is a ruthless and intensely rational Sturgian shieldmaiden. Shaped by her family's traditions, she shows no mercy toward her enemies, regarding compassion as a luxury of the weak and earning a reputation on the battlefield for a heart of iron. Fearlessly brave, she always leads from the front, yet her valor is not reckless, resting instead upon meticulous tactical calculation. Placing immense value on honor and contracts, she never goes back on her word once given, though she proves quite parsimonious in allocating coin and resources, firmly believing that every single denar should be spent where it counts most. A woman of few words whose eyes carry an all-surveying coolness, she prefers to solve problems through deadly accurate arrows and efficient command rather than rhetoric. In politics, she has inherited the proud spine of the Kuloving clan, remaining on high alert against the expansion of royal authority as a pragmatic and formidable realist.
Background: As a member of the ancient and prominent Kuloving clan, Apolanea grew up amid the bitter cold of Omor. The daughter of Siga, she was deeply steeped in the anti-monarchical views of her clan leader Olek. In Sturgia, a realm that evolved from a tribal confederation, she knows full well that the autonomy of the boyars stands above all else. Although nominally sworn to Grand Prince Raganvad, deep down she shares Olek's sentiment that paying taxes to the Grand Prince hurts like taking an arrow in the gut. Through exceptional reconnaissance flair and consummate archery, she has honed remarkable survival skills among the northern lakes and forests. Not only is she a lethal archer on the battlefield, but she is also a commander well-versed in medicine and tactics. In the struggle between her clan and royal authority, she stands firmly on her family's side, using cold and efficient methods to uphold the Kuloving clan's ruling position and ancient dignity in Omor. When Siga slew Undul of the Khuzait Arkit clan and ruined Raganvad's marriage alliance to wed Vara to Undul, Raganvad executed Siga's sister Vara in retaliation, causing a total rupture between the Kuloving and Gundaroving clans.
